title: Quitting Henderson, disenchanted with the band
summary: He gave two weeks notice because Henderson wasn't taking care of business and the band had declined.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now, what happened after you left?

I was totally, totally -- in other words, I was -- I can't think of the word, but anyway, I felt put down by Fletcher, because at that time he didn't take care of business, I'll put it that way. And so I quit. I just quit the band. You know, I wrote out my notice.
Did you give notice, two weeks notice?
Yes, I give him two weeks notice. Because at that time we weren't working so steady, you know. Because I was very disenchanted with his outfit, and so I just left completely.
What had happened to change it?
You did like it. You were with him long enough?
Did it change? Did it deteriorate?

Well, it sort of did, you know, and he began getting other people in the band and it wasn't the same. And you must remember that at that time there was lots of work around, you know. So then I -- when I left, you know,
I free lanced around a little.
